Bihar ke varisliganj vidhanasbha kshetr se aarjedi ke tikat par anita devi aur bijepi ke tikat par aruna devi maidan men hain. ye donon hi bite zamane ke bahubliyon ki patniyan hain. yah vidhanasbha sit navada lokasbha kshetr ke andar aati hai. varisliganj vidhanasbha kshetr men kya hain logon ke mudde aur kaisa hai chunavi mahaul?
